question: Which directly called video imports and progress interfaces must a detached renderer preserve?

scope.qualification: Direct mapped video import calls and selected preserved MMIO and shadow consumers, not arbitrary computed dispatch or runtime adequacy.

dependencies.use: Covers the distinct fence, ring, callback, scratch and retirement protocols.
Covers preserved display and timing, persistence allocation and free, and present-tail readers.
Covers default MMIO diagnostic callbacks and the open question of their qualified custom targets.

currentEvidence.method: Serial foreground tools/run-headless.ps1 -ReadOnly raw direct-BL census, native-word ranges and narrow exact-function generated corroboration. All 31 generated (PC,thunk) tuples matched the initialized-executable raw census without truncation or cancellation. Each expansion contained at most 8 functions.

additionalImportRows.effectDesign: General void support needs an explicit PreserveR3 no-write arm or separate stub. Three source-proven exact-value void subsets can instead use same-value scalar constants without an observable context change. additionalImportRows.remainingBoundary: The accepted census retains 11 other output and protocol import families at 18 direct PCs beyond the scaler and display cuts and the result and void contracts within the inspected scope. This classifies obligations and omits no actual call. Mode, gamma, display and system outputs, retrain retry and cursor, persistence allocation and free, delegate callback, ring and RPTR, and Swap, which applies only under conditions, retain their existing canonical contracts. Open questions about computed, interior, metadata, custom, variable and dynamic cases need the actual selected caller, target, ABI and occurrence.
